sitemap_watch_id_reconciliation.interpretation: The sitemap is a GLOBAL inventory (~81.5k canonical + ~10.7k per-audio-version watch pages); this database is the BD-region CMS view. Unexplained ids are episodes/movies of other regions (region-locked or simply not available in BD), plus per-audio-version pages of episodes absent here. Regional asymmetry is expected and quantified here rather than being a completeness defect.

live_drift_since_extraction.explanation: The catalog is live: e.g. an ongoing simulcast can publish a new episode between the crawl and this verification run. Extraction-time consistency is proven inside the census (browse episode_count == archived CMS media_count); live differences are documented, not defects.

music.coverage_note: Crunchyroll exposes NO global music enumeration (artists?/music_videos?/concerts? all 404 — live-probed). Music universe = broad search discovery + complete per-artist expansion (artists/{id}/music_videos, /concerts). Completeness is therefore search-coverage-based; see music.coverage.
